verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration and visa services firm, not a software agent or AI tool. Acting as an MCP client that consumes tools from plugged-in servers is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any agent or MCP client capability; its People Ops integration claim is an unrelated service workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
